correctness.rationale: The proof yields the full real characteristic polynomial for the exact graph in the Finding. Put n=q+1 and s=q−1. Each ordered kernel/image type contains s vertices; the incidence of types (i,j),(k,l) is j=k or l=i. Removing the self-loops gives H⊗J_s−D⊗I_s. The fiber sum-zero spaces give the displayed zero and −1 factors, while the type-constant operator is Bf_ij=s(r_j+c_i−f_ji)−1_{i=j}f_ii. Its skew differences a_i−a_j have eigenvalue −s(n−1); its skew row-null arrays have eigenvalue s. Its symmetric zero-diagonal row-null arrays have eigenvalue −s: the row-map transpose a↦(a_i+a_j)_{i<j} is injective for n≥3. The two remaining symmetric blocks use the constant diagonal/off-diagonal pair and the zero-sum diagonal/off-diagonal pair; substitution gives P_q and Q_q. The dimensions exhaust n². Both quadratics have negative constant term and neither vanishes at −1 (P_q(−1)=−(q−1)(2q²−q−2), Q_q(−1)=−q²(q−2)−1). The −s eigenspace vanishes at q=2, so rank, inertia and −1 multiplicity follow without exceptions; the energy follows from the positive square roots of the two discriminants and the remaining linear factors. The source script was inspected, not executed: its exact finite checks over F_2,F_3,F_4,F_5 corroborate the type criterion and quotient characteristic polynomial, and check the full polynomial at q=2,3. The proof, not the script, establishes the unbounded prime-power claim.
residual_risks: The checks and proof do not address multiplication over nonfields, directed adjacency or graphs with loops. No formal certificate is asserted.

value.rationale: This is a natural minimal noncommutative finite matrix family, not a single selected field or a tabulated graph. The full quotient splitting resolves an explicit gap in earlier spectral reductions: uniform exact multiplicities, rank, inertia and energy are usable without diagonalizing a separate growing matrix for each field order. In particular it shows the known lower bounds are sharp and treats even and extension fields with the same proof.
residual_risks: The value claim is for this graph family; extension to higher matrix size is not established.
